name: WebLogic Logs
about: Checks CMiC's AWS SaaS WebLogic log index for servers whose logs stopped updating; a growing count can mean servers or their log copying have stopped.
details: Runs on a server inside CMiC's network (the log index is VPN only) and counts servers whose log folder hasn't changed for 30 minutes. Servers silent for over a day are left out of the count. Server names go to Slack only. A rising count can mean application servers, or the copying of their logs, have stopped.
label: :scroll: *WebLogic Logs (AWS us-east-1)*
